correctness.rationale: Reduce each forbidden x_i+t_i Q=b mod ell to a residue c_i. Two-coordinate shifts (s,-s), s in {-1,0,1}, face at most two excluded candidates, since ell odd, establishing even m. For odd m pair all but three; the 19 zero-sum triples in [-2,2]^3 face at most 3*5=15 forbidden values for ell>=5. At ell=3, two-element allowed residue sets have full pairwise sumset, yielding a zero-sum residue triple; lift representatives in {-1,0,1} and, if their sum is ±3, change one ±1 by ∓3 into ∓2 to realize integer zero-sum. For c_i=0, radius0 impossible always and radius1 impossible when m odd by parity. Applying shifts tuplewise yields sumset inclusion, 3|F_i|/5|F_i| and displacement m B_m Q. Independent dynamic programming checked 3835 forbidden-residue vectors at ell=3,5,7,11 over nontrivial m ranges; finite checks corroborate, not replace all-prime proof.
